countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, US, KR)

diagnosticLevel.title: Diagnostic Level
diagnosticLevel.description: Troubleshooting only. Limits which HomeKit characteristics are exposed: 0 = only what HAP requires, 1 = + restricted mode list, 2 = + target temperature, 3 = + fan speed, 4 = everything (default). Leave unset for normal operation.
